comment: The opponents the page offers, weakest first: the ceramics ladder, from raw ground to precious glaze. Each dir holds a model.onnx + model_meta.json (the meta carries the Elo and parameter count the menu shows; run/checkpoint stay internal). Five of the swatch colours are the game's own tile glazes; Sand and Clay are the two raw earths beneath them. scripts/deploy_player.sh ships this whole tree.

reserved_for_future_nets.comment: The next rungs of the ladder, in order, for agents stronger than Cobalt. THE FULL SHIPPING PROCEDURE AND THE BAR (at least +150 wall-clock-honest Elo over the current strongest, gated over >=300 games at matched think time) IS IN docs/BOT_DEPLOYMENT.md — follow it; it is self-contained. Do not rename existing bots; the page defaults to the strongest by the elo in model_meta.json automatically. An entry with "experimental": true is hidden unless the player turns on 'Experimental opponents' in Settings, never becomes the default or the adviser, and needs no gate: it is how a net that is stronger but below the +150 bar can be offered (Lapis Lazuli, 2026-09-06, +109 over Porcelain over 300 games).
